name: Finance Trading OS
tagline: A unified workspace for market intelligence and trading workflows
description: Financial OS is a personal finance, investments, market intelligence and Indian tax workspace. The public site currently opens the Financial OS product landing/demo page.
install_note: Review the upstream README and backend/.env.example. Never commit real credentials, broker tokens, database passwords or gateway secrets.

install_guide.title: Frontend development
install_guide.command:
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev

install_guide.title: Backend development
install_guide.command:
cd backend
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
cp .env.example .env
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
install_guide.note: Requires Python 3.12 and a PostgreSQL-compatible database. Configure local .env values before starting.

install_guide.title: Production frontend
install_guide.command: AWS Amplify · main branch · app root: frontend/ · build: npm run build · output: dist
install_guide.note: The upstream README identifies Amplify as the frontend hosting target. Production deployment changes require the upstream release process.

name: Arox AI
tagline: An independent AI project from the Arox ecosystem
description: Arox AI is an AI-powered workforce orchestration platform with OmniRoute model routing, OpenCode coding workflows, n8n automation, PostgreSQL and Redis. The live URL currently displays its sign-in screen.
install_note: The upstream README specifies /opt/arox and AWS SSM parameters under /arox/. Keep all API keys, database passwords and bot tokens out of the repository.

install_guide.title: Prerequisites
install_guide.command:
Docker and Docker Compose
AWS CLI configured with access to the /arox/ SSM parameter path
install_guide.note: Use a controlled Linux server with resources appropriate for docker-compose.yml.

install_guide.title: Deploy on the configured server
install_guide.note: The script reads encrypted parameters from AWS SSM in us-east-1, writes a temporary protected environment file and runs docker compose up -d --build.

install_guide.title: Check services
install_guide.command:
cd /opt/arox
docker compose ps
docker compose logs -f <service_name>
install_guide.note: Do not expose internal database, Redis, OmniRoute or OpenCode ports publicly. Configure DNS/TLS and required secrets before deployment.
